events.verdict: Thompson (HOU) releases from Wallace (OKC) at the start of his drive to the basket.
Wallace (OKC) moves alongside Thompson's (HOU) path and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Caruso (OKC) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Thompson (HOU).
Adams (HOU) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Caruso (OKC) as attempts to secure the loose ball.
Thompson (HOU) cleanly deflects the ball away from Dort (OKC) as he attempts to secure the loose ball.
Smith Jr. (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) drive to the basket.

Replay review of the foul called on Smith Jr. (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Smith Jr. makes clean contact to the ball that causes Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) to briefly lose control. Any additional contact on the play is marginal. Since Gilgeous-Alexander had imminent possession of the ball at the point of interruption, OKC retains possession when play resumes.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) releases from Smith Jr. (HOU) as he steps back.
Caruso (OKC) and Sengun (HOU) briefly jostle for position in the post.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) initiates contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Holmgren (OKC) is off-balance as he engages with Adams (HOU) during the rebound. He does not fall to the floor as a result of any illegal contact.
Dort (OKC) extends his leg to the side as he returns to the floor, but the contact with Durant (HOU) is marginal.
Durant (HOU) directly contests Dort's (OKC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Dort's hand after the release.

Replay review of the foul called on Holmgren (OKC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Holmgren initiates illegal contact across Smith Jr.'s (HOU) arm, affecting his ability to control the rebound.
Caruso (OKC) places a hand against Sengun's (HOU) side before immediately removing it.
Caruso (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Sengun's (HOU) post up and shot attempt.
Caruso (OKC) has his arm slightly extended as he absorbs the contact with Thompson (HOU).
Dort (OKC) moves forward into Durant (HOU), initiating illegal contact to his lower body and arm that prevents him from following through during the jump shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) legally contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) legally contests Sengun's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) establishes position in Dort's (OKC) path and absorbs the incoming contact as the pick is set.
Holmgren (OKC) is not in a legal guarding position when he jumps to contest, initiating illegal contact to Sengun (HOU) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Okogie (HOU) establishes position in Hartenstein's (OKC) path when  he absorbs the incoming contact during the pick.
Okogie (HOU) extends an arm toward Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC), who lifts his own arm upwards into it. The contact between the two players is marginal.
Okogie (HOU) makes clean contact to the ball during Holmgren's (OKC) shot attempt near the basket.
Smith Jr. (HOU) subsequently blocks Holmgren's (OKC) shot attempt after the contact to the ball by Okogie (HOU). Any ensuing contact with Holmgren is incidental.
Holmgren's (OKC) momentum carries him into Okogie's (HOU) lower body, causing him to lose his balance.
Sengun (HOU) jumps vertically and absorbs the ensuing contact with Caruso (OKC) at the rim.
Smith Jr. (HOU) maintains his left pivot foot after gathering the ball.
Sengun (HOU) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before the shot attempt.
Caruso (OKC) defends Sengun (HOU) in the post and the contact is marginal.
Adams (HOU) loses his balance during the loose ball and the contact with Caruso's (OKC) head is incidental.
Okogie (HOU) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Eason (HOU) directly contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Gilgeous-Alexander's hand after the release.
After securing the rebound, Durant (HOU) signals for a timeout but it is not seen by the officials. If recognized, a technical foul would have been assessed to HOU for an excessive timeout.
Caruso (OKC) brushes Sengun's (HOU) arm as he reaches in and the contact is marginal.
Caruso (OKC) cleanly blocks Sengun's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) makes clean contact to the ball to deflect it away from Smith Jr. (HOU).
The shot clock expires while the ball is loose.
Sheppard (HOU) makes clean contact to the ball, causing Caruso (OKC) to briefly bobble it.
Hartenstein (OKC) initiates contact to Durant's (HOU) arm at the start of his upward shooting motion, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt and the contact to Gilgeous-Alexander's hand after the release is marginal.
Durant (HOU) firms up in a screening position and the contact to Wallace's (OKC) body as he moves around the screen is marginal.
Dort (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Durant (HOU).
Adams (HOU) initiates contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arm, affecting his SQBR.
Wallace (OKC) and Smith Jr. (HOU) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Dort (OKC) brushes Sengun's (HOU) arm after the gather and the contact does not affect his shot attempt.
Durant (HOU) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Durant (HOU) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) come together at the same spot at the start of the drive, and the foot to foot contact that occurs is incidental.
Durant (HOU) is drawn into the air on the pump fake towards Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) and initiates contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Williams (OKC) and Sengun (HOU) briefly engage and separate as the screen is set by Smith Jr. (HOU).
Williams (OKC) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jump shot attempt.
